heading: The professional bit.
intro: Nahim is a JNC-qualified youth worker and senior leader with over fifteen years across the voluntary, public and private sectors, all of it focused on young people and communities in East London.

columns.title: Current role
items: Head of Strategic Engagement (Youth & Community), Poplar HARCA and Spotlight — Poplar HARCA’s award-winning youth service in Tower Hamlets. He leads youth engagement and empowerment teams and the programmes they deliver.
